explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at the GO step when the agent picks a1 and the previous trial went a1 to S2 (rare) and paid nothing: then it is 9-10 in the last few trials of the episode (about trial 93-99), but only about 1-2 earlier in the episode. A1 choices after an unrewarded common trial get at most 1, and D1, D2 and any a2 choice are always 0.
